name: WooCommerce
description: An open-source eCommerce platform built on WordPress allowing businesses to sell physical and digital products, manage orders, and handle customers.

evidence.claim: WooCommerce provides a REST API that connects stores to external systems using consumer keys and consumer secrets.
For Authorization, choose basic auth and enter your consumer key and consumer secret keys from WooCommerce into the username and password fields.
WooCommerce includes native support for the Model Context Protocol (MCP), enabling AI assistants and tools to interact directly with WooCommerce stores.

notes: WooCommerce REST API uses consumer keys and consumer secrets passed via basic authentication or OAuth 1.0a / OAuth2 depending on the setup. It also includes native Model Context Protocol (MCP) support.
